body:
Pick up a table tennis paddle, drop a ping-pong ball onto it from no more than 15 cm, and keep it bouncing on the red face ten times in a row, each bounce 10 to 25 cm high. It tests sustained rhythmic, dynamic control: each tap has to add back what the bounce loses, with the face level to a degree or so, or the ball dies away or walks off the edge.

- Category: Societal relatability
- Scripted demo: 1.0 (success at step 256 of 1,200; identical on two runs)
- Dream-1: 0.0 (1,200 steps)
- Counterfactuals: paddle held still under a 12 cm drop 0; a 25 cm drop over a still paddle 0 (too high)

See `tasks/paddle-bounce-ping-pong/README.md` for sources, geometry, scoring and run commands.
